body: did you know: taylor is the first artist ever to land four songs in the adult contemporary top 10 in the same week -- and none of them off a christmas album, the only reason anyone had ever come close. a first in 65 years of the chart. and this week, all four of them climbed.
why: Did-you-know / chart-record pillar, anchored to the AC chart dated today (July 25, 2026) where all four songs climbed to Nos. 6-9. Sourced from the vault TLOAS chart page (ledger #1438) and corroborated live by Billboard/Forbes (first non-seasonal artist with four AC top-10s, chart running since July 1961). No claim about Taylor personally -- pure chart fact, outside every blocklist topic.
